# Default routing only. The peer grants nothing and starts no local process.
skygo --json run -f plain.yaml --request-id ordinary-1
stdout 'JOB_STATE_QUEUED'
skygo --json run -f retry.yaml --request-id retry-1
stdout 'JOB_STATE_QUEUED'
skygo --json run -f plain.yaml --request-domain aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa:1 --request-id retained-1
stdout 'JOB_STATE_QUEUED'
# This Ref is a wire fixture, not an actual uploaded workspace.
skygo --json run -f workdir.yaml --request-id workspace-1
stdout 'JOB_STATE_QUEUED'
calls SubmitJob 1
calls SubmitRetryJob 1
calls SubmitRetainedJob 1
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 1
calls SubmitDataJob 0
calls BeginArtifactUpload 0

-- plain.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: local

-- retry.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: local
retry:
  max_attempts: 2
  delay_seconds: 0
  exit_codes: [7]

-- workdir.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: local
workdir:
  id: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  sha256: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  size: 1024
